title: The Strange Mouse Cursor
overview: During IT class, Takumi notices that his mouse cursor has sprung out of the screen. He asks his childhood friend Mone, who's sitting next to him, if she can see it, but she can't and just makes fun of him… Assuming she can't see it, Takumi slips the cursor into the gap in Mone's clothes and starts clicking on her body! As he continues clicking on Mone, who's writhing in pleasure from this unfamiliar sensation, the words "The Real Deal" eventually appear in the right-click menu… Huh? "The Real Deal", is that what I think it is?!
